system: Noise-injected Adler (1D phase): dtheta = (dw - 2K sin theta) dt + sigma dW, R = |<exp(i theta)>|
zero_noise_closed_form: R0(dw) = (dw - sqrt(dw^2 - 4*K^2)) / (2*K), valid for dw > 2K; p0(theta) ∝ 1/(dw - 2K sin theta) (constant-flux PF solution, Laplace endpoint at s=0)

method_notes.PF: exact finite-D stationary density p(theta) ∝ ∫_0^{2π} exp(-(dw*s + 2K(cos(theta+s)-cos theta))/D) ds; Nth x Ns = 2048 x 800 clustered (t^4) grid; grid-convergence deltas 1.9e-4..2.6e-4
method_notes.R0: closed form cross-checked against direct 2π quadrature of 1/f to 1.1e-16
method_notes.MC: Euler-Maruyama, 256 walkers, dt=0.02, 500s burn-in, 5000s measurement, fresh seed

caveat: Constant-flux integral has an O(D/dw) boundary layer at s=0. The t^4 clustered grid (Ns=400) resolves it only down to D ~ 1e-3. At D=5e-7 (sigma=0.001) the quadrature under-resolves: PF=0.510920 vs R0_closed=0.527112 at dw=4 (delta 1.6e-2) — grid artifact, NOT a physical deviation from the closed form.
